name: @activepieces/piece-zoo
description: Generate and iterate on 3D models from text descriptions using ML endpoints.

generate_cad_model.name: generate_cad_model
generate_cad_model.description: Generate a 3D model from text prompt

aiMetadata.description: Submit a text prompt to Zoo's text-to-CAD ML model to generate a new 3D model in a chosen export format (FBX, GLB, GLTF, OBJ, PLY, STEP, or STL). Each call starts a new generation job, so it is not idempotent. Optionally include KCL source in the output; retrieve finished results with the get CAD model action.

kcl_completions.name: kcl_completions
kcl_completions.description: Get code completions for KCL (Kernel Configuration Language)

prompt.description: The KCL code prompt to get completions for

temperature.description: Controls randomness in completion generation (0.0 to 1.0)

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

stop.description: Sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens

aiMetadata.description: Generate KCL (Zoo Kernel Configuration Language) code completions from a prompt using Zoo's ML model. Pick when authoring or extending KCL scripts for CAD geometry. Output varies between calls (non-deterministic) and is tunable via temperature, max tokens, and stop sequences.

text_to_cad_iteration.name: text_to_cad_iteration
text_to_cad_iteration.description: Create a new iteration of an existing 3D model

aiMetadata.description: Generate a new CAD model iteration from a text prompt describing desired changes. Use to refine or evolve a design via natural language; to rate an existing result instead, use give-model-feedback. Not idempotent: each call starts a fresh generation, so avoid blind retries.

list_cad_models.name: list_cad_models
list_cad_models.description: Retrieve a list of your generated 3D models

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return

aiMetadata.description: List the text-to-CAD 3D models generated by the authenticated user, with optional limit/offset paging. Use to browse past generations or find a model ID to feed into give-model-feedback or an iteration. Read-only with no side effects.

get_cad_model.name: get_cad_model
get_cad_model.description: Retrieve details of a specific 3D model

modelId.description: The ID of the model to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Look up a single previously generated text-to-CAD model by its model ID, including its status and conversion results. Read-only and repeatable. Use to poll or fetch a model created by the generate CAD model action; requires a known model ID.

give_model_feedback.name: give_model_feedback
give_model_feedback.description: Provide feedback on a generated 3D model

modelId.description: The ID of the model to give feedback on

get_async_operation.name: get_async_operation

get_center_of_mass.name: get_center_of_mass
get_center_of_mass.description: Calculate the center of mass of a CAD file

aiMetadata.description: Compute the center-of-mass coordinates of a 3D solid from an uploaded CAD file (FBX, GLB, glTF, OBJ, PLY, STEP, or STL). Pick this for the centroid/balance-point specifically; sibling actions cover mass, density, volume, and surface area. Read-only analysis that does not modify the file and returns the same value for the same input.

convert_cad_file.name: convert_cad_file
convert_cad_file.description: Convert a CAD file from one format to another

aiMetadata.description: Convert an uploaded CAD file from one 3D format to another; both source and output formats must be chosen from FBX, GLB, glTF, OBJ, PLY, STEP, and STL. Use this for format translation only, not for measuring mass properties (see the get-mass/volume/density/surface-area/center-of-mass actions). The source file is left untouched and the conversion is deterministic for the same inputs.

get_density.name: get_density

Read-only analysis that does not modify the file and returns the same value for the same input.
